name: Kynver
description: Unverified AI agents are a growing security risk. Kynver's MCP server brings agent trust directly into your IDE — resolve agents by DID, check verification status and trust scores, register new agents, and complete ownership challenges or KYC without switching context.

KYNVER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Required for authenticated tools (e.g. verify_ownership, start_kyc, submit_questionnaire, get_tracking_setup). Get a key from Dashboard → your agent → Settings → API Keys.

KYNVER_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Kynver app (default: https://kynver.com).
